loadUnpacked.description: Load an unpacked extension directory without the native file picker, via the browser-level CDP method Extensions.loadUnpacked (no page session attached). Restores the previously active session afterward.

path.description: Absolute path to the unpacked extension directory (contains manifest.json).

extensionInfo.description: Compact status of one extension from chrome.developerPrivate.getExtensionInfo, run inside a chrome://extensions page (opened in the background and closed again if none is open).

returns.description: {id, name, version, state, path, manifestErrors, runtimeErrors:{count, messages:[{id, severity, occurrences, source, message}]}}

reloadExtension.description: Reload an extension via chrome.developerPrivate.reload with failQuietly, so a bad manifest returns the load error instead of throwing.

clearExtensionErrors.description: Delete every recorded runtime error of an extension (chrome.developerPrivate.deleteExtensionErrors), so the next extensionInfo shows only fresh errors.

setDeveloperMode.description: Turn the chrome://extensions Developer mode switch on or off (chrome.developerPrivate.updateProfileConfiguration) and read it back. Unpacked extensions need it on to stay enabled across restarts.

returns.description: {inDeveloperMode: boolean}, the state after the change.
